name: x402
status: Open payment protocol under the x402 Foundation (Linux Foundation): intent announced 2026-04-02; operational launch and completed contribution by Coinbase announced 2026-07-14, with 40 member organisations at launch. On 2026-10-13 main is at commit 6c470a8 and the core specification header reads "Protocol Version: 2" (specs/x402-specification-v2.md); no release is listed on GitHub (not found, 2026-10-13). The file ROADMAP.md, which read "(update coming soon)" on 2026-10-03, was removed from main on 2026-10-13 by PR #3789, "chore: remove outdated ROADMAP.md and PROJECT-IDEAS.md".
relevance: The README says "x402 is an open standard for internet native payments."; the server answers 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, the client replies with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and an http-message-signatures extension identifies the paying agent. The offer-and-receipt extension lets the server "cryptographically commit to the payment terms it presents in" accepts[] (the payment terms of the offer, not the commercial terms of the sale) and sign a receipt; it says "Wire shape and field placement are not considered stable". The FAQ describes the exact scheme as a push payment, "irreversible once executed".
boundary: The FAQ answers "Not natively." on credit-card deposits, placing fiat rails outside the protocol.

evidence.read: On 2026-10-13 (fetch of the repository, commit 6c470a8): TSC.md, README.md, the core specification header, specs/extensions/extension-offer-and-receipt.md (still "Wire shape and field placement are not considered stable"), docs/faq.md, and the state of PRs #1986, #3220, #3656, #3789 and issues #2887, #2906, #3500. x402-foundation/x402, 2026-10-03: main branch read (README, TSC.md, ROADMAP, specs, docs, Technical Charter), issues and pull requests updated since 2026-03-01, and the two Linux Foundation releases.
evidence.not_read: Slack, the tsc and wg-identity repositories, x402.org member and calendar pages, older items; usage figures on x402.org (self-reported).
